altText: Cover slide on dark slate; Swahili: Ishara 3 kwamba mwanachama anaondoka.; English: 3 signs a member is about to leave.
Point 01 slide; Swahili: Ziara zinapungua.; English: Fewer visits than before. The first sign, and the one most owners miss.
Point 02 slide; Swahili: Hajaingia kwa wiki.; English: No check-in for weeks. The app marks them at risk.
Point 03 slide; Swahili: Renewal imepita kimya.; English: Renewal day passes with no payment and no goodbye.
Point 04 slide; Swahili: Unaona zote kwenye app.; English: FitFlex shows all three before it’s too late, and lets you message them from the app.
Call to action; Swahili: Una gym Dar es Salaam? Andika; English: Own a gym in Dar es Salaam? Comment; Keyword PARTNER. Tutakutumia DM jinsi FitFlex inavyofanya kazi. We’ll DM you how FitFlex works.

instagram.text:
Ishara tatu kwamba mwanachama anaondoka: ziara zinapungua, hajaingia kwa wiki, renewal imepita kimya. FitFlex inakuonyesha zote tatu kabla hajaondoka, na unaweza kumtumia ujumbe kutoka kwenye app.
Una gym Dar es Salaam? Andika PARTNER.

Three signs a member is about to leave: fewer visits, no check-in for weeks, a renewal that passes quietly. FitFlex shows all three before it’s too late. Own a gym in Dar? Comment PARTNER.
